# Once Upon A You

> Personalised AI children's books where the child themselves — photo-matched, not just name-inserted — is the hero of their own story.

Once Upon A You is a UK personalised publishing site. Parents and grandparents upload a photo and a few details about a child, and the site generates a fully illustrated storybook in which that child is the actual hero — photo-matched illustrations throughout, not simply their name dropped into a generic template. Books are available as ebook, softcover, or a hardcover bundle.

## Audience

UK parents and grandparents aged 25 to 55 looking for a unique, personalised gift for a child aged 2 to 10 — birthdays, Christmas, and other gifting occasions.

## Topics

- Personalised, photo-matched children's storybooks
- How the personalisation and illustration process works
- Gifting occasions for a personalised book
- What makes a genuinely personalised book different from name-insertion books
- Parent and family reactions to receiving a finished book
